title: Moroccan Mechoui Lamb Tagine
description: A hearty, slow-cooked lamb dish inspired by traditional Moroccan cuisine. The rich flavors and tender meat make it perfect for a special occasion.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large Dutch oven over medium heat.
Add the onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic and ginger and cook for another minute.
Add the lamb and cook until browned on all sides, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the Moroccan spice blend, salt, and black pepper. Stir to combine.
Add the dried apricots and enough water to cover the lamb.
Bring to a boil, then cover and transfer to the oven.
Braise the lamb for 2-1/2 to 3 hours, or until tender and falling apart.
Remove from the oven and let rest for 10 minutes before slicing.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley.
